description: This file defines the `ReviewerRatingDecorator` class, which is a decorator for the `ReviewerRating` entity in the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to interact with `ReviewerRating` objects, including setting related KPI entities by ID, and includes traits for ORM helper functions.

classes.name: ReviewerRatingDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the ReviewerRating entity providing additional behavior such as setting KPI references.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a ReviewerRating entity.

methods.name: setKpiByKpiId
methods.description: Sets the KPI for the reviewer rating by the KPI's ID.
